note: NECO Biology top-up (round 2): grows the bank to 150 items so students get two full 60-question papers without repeats. Fresh scenario angles - mitochondria in muscle, cellulose crunch, RBC anucleate, plasmolysis, meiosis and gametes, villi absorption, phloem ringing, universal donor, lactic acid, nephron, dialysis, cotyledons, epigeal germination, identical twins, femur, synapse, cerebellum, gigantism, sickle-carrier cross, commensalism, treated nets, Benedict's and emulsion tests - near-dup scanned against the JAMB, WAEC and existing NECO banks.
